subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 06/10] mountd: bound the junction path before copying it into e_path

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch fixes a potential heap corruption issue in the mountd service by adding bounds checking to ensure that junction paths do not exceed the maximum allowed length before copying them into the e_path field of an exportent structure. This is done by checking the length of the junction path and rejecting it if it exceeds the limit, rather than attempting to copy it directly. The patch addresses a specific vulnerability where a malicious user could set up a trusted.junction.nfs xattr to create a deep junction path that would corrupt the heap.
